title: Novel Cinnamic Acid Derivatives Containing Naproxen as NLRP3 Inhibitors: Synthesis and Evaluation of Their Biological Activity.
authors: Yu, Jialin; You, Zonglin; Wong, Vincent Kam Wai; Chen, Min; Liu, Wenfeng
one_liner_zh: 该文研究萘普生肉桂酸衍生物作为NLRP3抑制剂，涉及小分子-蛋白互作，与蛋白质-DNA互作及TF-DNA体系无关。
abstract: Long-term use of naproxen can lead to serious side effects. Inspired by the biological activity of cinnamic acid, a series of cinnamic acid derivatives containing naproxen were designed and synthesized, and their anti-inflammatory activities and mechanisms were explored in vitro. Our results indicated that all of naproxen derivatives showed more significant inhibition against lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-induced nitric oxide (NO) production and had a lower degree of cytotoxicity than that of naproxen. The present studies revealed that compound 23 (IC(50) = 5.66 +/- 1.66 microM) markedly inhibited the LPS-induced NO production and the over-expression of pro-inflammatory cytokines, including interleukin (IL)-1beta, inducible NO synthase (iNOS), and cyclooxygenase-2 (COX-2). Furthermore, it blocked the activation of NF-kappaB signaling pathway and pyrin domain-containing protein 3 (NLRP-3) inflammasome in a concentration-dependent manner. Additionally, docking studies confirmed that compound 23 exhibited a well-fitting into the NLRP3 active site. Considering these results, compound 23 might be a novel NLRP3 inhibitor to treat inflammatory diseases.
abstract_zh: 长期使用萘普生可能导致严重副作用。受肉桂酸生物活性的启发，设计并合成了一系列含萘普生的肉桂酸衍生物，并在体外探讨了其抗炎活性及机制。结果表明，所有萘普生衍生物对脂多糖（LPS）诱导的一氧化氮（NO）产生均表现出更显著的抑制作用，且细胞毒性程度低于萘普生。本研究发现，化合物23（IC(50) = 5.66 ± 1.66 微摩尔）显著抑制LPS诱导的NO产生及促炎细胞因子（包括白细胞介素（IL）-1β、诱导型一氧化氮合酶（iNOS）和环氧合酶-2（COX-2））的过度表达。此外，它以浓度依赖性方式阻断NF-κB信号通路和含吡啶结构域蛋白3（NLRP-3）炎症小体的激活。同时，分子对接研究证实，化合物23能良好地嵌入NLRP3活性位点。综合这些结果，化合物23可能是一种新型NLRP3抑制剂，用于治疗炎症性疾病。
